summary.description: One paragraph (2-4 sentences) framing the learner's program. Surfaced on the Program Preview hero card before the user commits to full generation.

duration_weeks.description: Estimated total program duration in weeks. Null if duration depends on outcomes rather than calendar time.

normalized_topic.description: Lowercase canonical slug for the topic (e.g. 'haskell', 'organic_chemistry'). Used for retrieval; null if no clean slug fits.

stages.description: All stages of the program, in order. Each stage is one coarse phase the learner moves through. Sprints, sessions, and blocks are NOT generated at outline scope — those come on confirmation.

intent.description: One sentence describing what this stage moves the learner toward.
